tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. chA:A.23↗ thm:local-embedding-theorem Suppose $\bar{M}$ is a smooth manifold and $M \subseteq \bar{M}$ is an embedded submanifold. Every smooth function $f:M\to \mathbb {R}$ extends to a smooth function on a neighborhood of $M$ in $\bar{M}$ whose restriction to $M$ is $f$. If $M$ is closed in $\bar{M}$, the extension can be defined on all of $\bar{M}$.
